name: What types of windows can be repaired if they are sticking?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows can be repaired if they are sticking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most common window types can be repaired if they are sticking. This includes single-hung, double-hung, casement, and sliding windows, whether they have wood, vinyl, or aluminum frames. The repair method will vary depending on the window type and material. For example, wood windows might require sanding or rot repair, while vinyl or aluminum windows might need track cleaning or hardware replacement. A professional can assess the feasibility of repair for your specific window type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most common window types—single-hung, double-hung, casement, and sliding, with wood, vinyl, or aluminum frames—can typically be repaired when sticking.
